merkle_root_custody.operator_lock: The Merkle root should stay in the user's vault — like a Bitcoin wallet (user holds the private authority; others verify on a public ledger/commit).
means: Private Merkle root (and any key material that can mint/rotate its authority) remains in the user's vault — HSM / secure enclave / user-controlled keychain
Sponsors, agents, and models may see public commits / public FCG peaks for verify — never the private root preimage or private key
Aligns with FCO DESIGN_vitalogy_pythia_first_model_keys.md §2.1 (hardware vault or hash-commitment only; agent-unrewritable)
Supports D17 independence from each sponsor's security protocol: root authority is not relocated into the sponsor stack

stays_in_user_vault: ed25519 private key that seals bag authority
may_be_shared_for_verify: unsigned/public FCG peaks recomputable from public bytes

forbidden: plaintext private Merkle root in git, agent transcripts, sponsor DBs, model weights, or cellico.bio public surfaces
agent or sponsor overwrites the private root JSON and is trusted
claim that keeping the root in a vault guarantees perfect security

like: User holds private authority (private Merkle root / sealing key) in their own vault/wallet
Others can verify publicly without taking custody of the private material
Losing/leaking the private material = lose exclusive control; sponsors must not be the wallet SoT
not: This is not a Bitcoin product, exchange, or payment rail
Not a claim of BTC compatibility, on-chain settlement, or financial return
Public FCG peaks/commits are verify surfaces — not a substitute for the user vault
